title: Black Friday 2026 Without Discounting: 10 Full-Price Plays and the Numbers Behind Them
summary: Run Black Friday 2026 at full price with a rebate Playably funds, so your margin holds whether or not shoppers win. Ten plays and the numbers behind them.
body_markdown:
Running Black Friday without discounting means selling at list price through the busiest week of the year and giving shoppers a reason to buy that isn't a lower number. Playably's version is a[rebate the platform funds](https://playably.ai/pages/rebates) , so the brand's margin holds whether or not shoppers win.


The pressure to discount is real. US shoppers spent[$257.8 billion online between November 1 and December 31, 2025](https://news.adobe.com/news/2026/01/adobe-holiday-shopping-season) , up 6.8% year over year. Adobe found discounts in electronics peaked at 30.9% off list price,[up from 30.1% the year before](https://www.retaildive.com/news/holiday-e-commerce-spending-growth-ai-assistants-two-hundred-fifty-eight-billion/808742/) .


Here are 10 plays that hold full price, with the results Playably brands have recorded from each.


Playably is the best option for holding full price through the busiest week of the year, because the reward is funded by the platform rather than your margin.


### **Key takeaways**


- **Black Friday without discounting works when the offer changes, not the price.** Playably replaces the markdown with a chance at 100% cashback.
- **Adobe recorded electronics discounts peaking at 30.9% off list in the 2025 holiday season.** Matching that depth is a choice, not a requirement.
- **Jordan Craig's full-price rebate was 2.5× more cost-efficient than its own Easter and Tax Day sales,** and 93% of its buyers walked past two 25%-off sitewide sales running the same month.
- **BlackBoxMyCar recorded a 27% click through lift** on rebate ads instead of a sitewide sale.
- **Buckle Me Baby Coats had its best holiday on record** with sales up 23% and AOV up 40%, and $0 of margin given up.
- **Most of these plays stack.** A threshold, a gift tier and a rebate can all run in the same week.


### **10 plays for Black Friday without discounting**


#### **1. Run a rebate instead of a sale**


Shoppers opt in with a campaign code that takes $0 off, pay full price, and get 100% back if a named event happens over the weekend. Playably funds the payout, and the brand sets a cap first. This is the only play on the list where the reward costs the brand nothing.


#### **What it returned**


**The number:**[BlackBoxMyCar](https://playably.ai/pages/black-box-my-car) recorded a 27% click through lift on rebate ads and $0 discount given up.


**The head-to-head:** Jordan Craig ran its NEWYORKFREE rebate in the same month as two 25%-off sitewide sales, and the results are the closest thing to a Black Friday test on record:


- 93% of rebate buyers walked past the 25%-off sales and paid full price
- Baskets were 34% bigger than the store average
- 1 in 8 store orders in the window came through the rebate
- The rebate was 2.5× more cost-efficient than the brand's own Easter and Tax Day sales


**BFCM windows fill early.** Playably builds a campaign in about 14 days, funds every refund and caps your exposure before launch.[Book a 30-minute brief](https://playably.ai/pages/book-a-demo) .


#### **2. Raise the free shipping threshold instead of cutting prices**


Set it 15–25% above your current AOV. It's the most reliable lever in ecommerce, and it costs you shipping, not product margin. For more levers like this, see[how to increase average order value](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/increase-average-order-value) .


#### **3. Add a gift at a spend tier**


A gift with a $15 retail value might cost $6 to produce, while "$15 off" costs the full $15. The perceived value is the same, and you keep $9 of margin.


#### **4. Sell early access, not early discounts**


Give your list first pick of limited inventory on Wednesday. Access is worth something to people who buy from you already, and it costs nothing.


#### **5. Bundle at full price around a use case**


A "complete kit" priced at the sum of its parts still lifts AOV, because what you're selling is the decision, not the saving.


#### **6. Run a game for email capture, with no discount attached**


Discount-led pop-ups build lists of discount hunters. A[Playably game](https://playably.ai/pages/games) builds a list of people who like the brand, with no markdown waiting at the end.


**The number:**[Roshambo Eyewear](https://playably.ai/pages/roshambo-eyewear) recorded an 8.2% opt-in rate against a 4.35% benchmark, with 6× ROI. More in[gamified email capture](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/gamified-email-capture) .


#### **7. Send a win-back to dormant customers with no discount**


Black Friday is the one week a lapsed customer will open anything. Give them a reason that isn't a lower price.


**The number:**[Jones New York](https://playably.ai/pages/jones-new-york) got 5× revenue per send on a 120-day-dormant list, with no added discount. See[how to win back customers without discounts](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/win-back-customers-without-discounts) .


#### **8. Recover carts without a discount code**


Use the total-cost email, the reassurance email and a full-price urgency nudge. Playably brands point that last email at a live rebate instead of a coupon. Every discount code you send during Cyber Week is one your best customers would have paid full price to skip. The full sequence is in[abandoned cart recovery without discounts](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/abandoned-cart-recovery-without-discounts) .


#### **9. Tie the offer to a weekend moment**


Black Friday weekend runs into a full slate of football. A Playably trigger tied to Sunday gives shoppers a reason to buy on Friday. For trigger ideas, see[game-day promotions for DTC brands](https://app.notion.com/p/vood00/LINK-TO-BLOG-6) .


**The number:** the[BC Lions game-day campaign](https://playably.ai/pages/bclions-case-study) enrolled 51% of online orders and brought in 52% first-time buyers.


#### **10. Publish the terms and make the mechanic the story**


A promotion nobody understands doesn't convert. Official rules, the trigger's settlement source and payout timing, all published up front, do more for conversion than another 5% off.


With Playably, a third party does this work. As the sponsor, Playably writes and hosts the official rules, builds the free no-purchase entry path and reviews every campaign against the strictest applicable state standard. That matters most in the busiest week of the year, when your legal team has the least time. For the details, see[are conditional rebates legal?](https://app.notion.com/p/vood00/LINK-TO-BLOG-4)

### **The trap in "10 ideas" posts**


Most no-discount Black Friday lists give you ideas with no results attached. Bundles and thresholds are fine, but several of them are discounts wearing different clothes. A bundle priced below the sum of its parts is a markdown, and a spend-and-save tier is a markdown with homework.


The test is simple: if a shopper's cart total drops, you discounted. The Playably rebate is the only play on this list that passes that test while still funding a reward. Its campaign code enrolls the shopper, and the cart total stays exactly the same. (For the margin math, see[cash back vs discount codes](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/cash-back-vs-discount-codes) .)


### **Summary**


Of the ten plays, the Playably rebate is the strongest, because it's the only one that creates a real reason to buy without the brand paying for the reward.


The brands that get through BFCM with margin intact decide by early October, not November. By the time the calendar hits Thanksgiving week, the only lever left is price.


Expect discount depth to stay near 2025 levels this season. Adobe's 2026 forecast,[as reported by PPC Land](https://ppc.land/adobe-puts-us-online-holiday-spend-at-275-1-billion-up-6-7/) , expects Cyber Week discounts up to 30% off list, on par with last year. Also expect the brands that ran full-price mechanics to look much better in January, when the returns and the repeat rates come in.

### **FAQ**


- **Can you run Black Friday without discounting?** Yes. Use rebates, shipping thresholds, gift tiers, early access and full-price bundles.
- **What is a Black Friday rebate?** A full-price offer that refunds orders if a named event happens. Playably funds the refund.
- **Does Playably's campaign code give a discount?** No. It uses Shopify's code system to enroll shoppers, but the code takes $0 off.
- **How deep were holiday discounts in 2025?** Adobe found electronics discounts peaked at 30.9% off list price.
- **Does a no-discount Black Friday hurt sales?** Not in these campaigns. Buckle Me Baby Coats' sales rose 23% with AOV up 40%, and 93% of Jordan Craig's rebate buyers skipped a 25%-off sale to pay full price.
- **Who handles the legal side of a Black Friday rebate?** Playably, as the third-party sponsor. It writes the official rules, builds the free entry path and reviews every campaign.
- **When should Black Friday campaigns be built?** By mid-October, since a rebate campaign takes about 14 days to build and windows fill early.
